notes.title: Discover a Cute, Cozy Idle Game Where Pandas Run a Laundromat!
notes.content:
Our friends over at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45181686]Destroyer Doggo[/url] have created an adorable and relaxing idle game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3194550/Bao_Baos_Cozy_Laundromat/ ]Bao Bao’s Cozy Laundromat[/url]. Step into the world of Bao Bao, the lovable panda, and manage a bustling laundromat with colorful washing machines, dryers, and panda helpers taking care of the shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44854672/922e170cc15b932c768bb9dacfea2d59fe500d88.png[/img]

Customize your space with charming decorations like plants, chairs, vending machines, and even adorable cats! Streamers can engage their audience with built-in Twitch chat support, while multitaskers will love the dock mode, perfect for occasional management while working or relaxing. 

Discover the cozy charm of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3194550/Bao_Baos_Cozy_Laundromat/]Bao Bao’s Cozy Laundromat[/url] today—visit the Steam store page to learn more and grab the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3194550/Bao_Baos_Cozy_Laundromat/

notes.title: Demo Available: పల్లెటూరు - Palm Sugar: A Village Story
notes.content:
We're excited to share that the demo for పల్లెటూరు - Palm Sugar: A Village Story is available to play.

Follow our Steam page to stay updated with the latest news, updates, and future releases. We're eager to hear from the community and will be on the lookout for your feedback. Hope you have a fun time playing through it.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Demo Delay : పల్లెటూరు - Palm Sugar: A Village Story
notes.content:
[b]Demo Delay Announcement: పల్లెటూరు - Palm Sugar: A Village Story[/b]

We were excited to share that the demo for [b]పల్లెటూరు - Palm Sugar: A Village Story[/b] was scheduled to go live today at 18:00 hrs (India time). Unfortunately, due to unexpected issues with our Steam store page not going live on time, the demo has been delayed.

We understand how frustrating this can be and sincerely apologize for the delay. Rest assured, the demo will be made available as soon as our Steam page goes live. We're working closely with Steam to resolve this issue as quickly as possible.

Please follow our Steam page to stay updated, and we truly appreciate your patience and understanding during this time. Your support means a lot to us, and we can't wait for you to experience the game!

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Demo Launch Announcement: పల్లెటూరు - Palm Sugar: A Village Story
